purpose: Record the physical convergence of RedCap project assets under assets/ while preserving old path compatibility for scripts, reports, receipts, and archaeology.
problem: Project assets were spread across compass/docs, compass/knowledge, references, prism/reports, and private-archive. Indexes and package exclusions reduced token and leak risk, but the repository shape still looked like several competing asset systems.
solution: Move real project-asset content under assets/ and leave old roots as compatibility shims. Package candidate globs now point at assets/references so npm dry-run sees the real files instead of relying on symlink packing.
effect: Humans can understand one project asset parent; first-read surfaces point to assets/ as the default entry; existing tools and historical references continue to work through compatibility paths; package readiness checks no longer depend on symlink inclusion.

canonical_assets.assets/docs: Design docs, specs, research, traces, recent task reports, and docs catalog.
canonical_assets.assets/knowledge: Active lessons, host notes, runtime memory explanations, and LLM-wiki-lite assets.
canonical_assets.assets/references: Machine-readable contracts, policies, backlogs, handoff docs, and lookup dictionary.
canonical_assets.assets/evidence/prism-reports: Formal Prism review reports and report index.
canonical_assets.assets/private-archive: Private cold archive and old archaeology evidence.

compatibility_shims.reason: Existing docs catalog commands, task reports, and old links still use compass/docs.
Existing knowledge index, lessons references, and revival instructions still use compass/knowledge.
Control-plane scripts still resolve references/* as the logical contract entry.
Prism report index and old formal review evidence links remain stable.
Old receipt and report anchors remain stable while the real cold archive lives under assets.

first_read_policy.legacy_paths_are: compatibility shims and archaeology anchors only
first_read_policy.guard: redcap-root-information-architecture-check validates active first-read markdown links do not point at legacy shim paths

not_claimed: This task does not delete historical assets.
This task does not move prism/runs raw evidence.
This task does not complete formal public release.
This task does not implement GraphRAG or full LLM-wiki.
